test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question: Which of these is NOT true?

options.text: People who lead a luxurious life are expected to entertain lavishly.
A low-income person is considered worthy if he pays bills on time.
The author is at liberty to be extravagant at all times.
The rich amass wealth by spending money economically.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'The author is at liberty to be extravagant at all times.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage explicitly states that the author does not fall into the extremes of always being extravagant or always being mean. 
 
• The author mentions, "If I have money to spare I can be extravagant, but when, as is usually the case, I am hard up and then I am the meanest man imaginable.&quo
